issue.title: Convert layer weights even within nested Functional models.

repository.name: tensorflow
repository.description: An Open Source Machine Learning Framework for Everyone

body:
A workaround to patch the module before the new Tensorflow is released (or for older TF 2 installations):

```
import importlib
from tensorflow.python.keras.saving import hdf5_format

filename = hdf5_format.__file__
with open(filename, 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()
if "['Model', 'Sequential']" in content:
    print(f'Patching {filename} to support nested Functional model...')
    content = content.replace("['Model', 'Sequential']", "['Model', 'Sequential', 'Functional']")
    with open(filename, 'w') as f:
        f.write(content)

    importlib.reload(hdf5_format)
```

issue.title: Loading weights from tf.compat.v1.keras.layers.CuDNNLSTM to tf2.keras.layers.LSTM

labels.name: type:support

issue.body:
Hi, 

I am new to Keras and have been using tf.compat.v1.keras.layers.CuDNNLSTM  in my network architecture.

It seems to be a faster implementation for training compared to the tf2 LSTM ( Cudnn ) version. 

Is there a way to load the weights from a model trained with tf.compat.v1.keras.layers.CuDNNLSTM  to tf2's LSTM. Loading the weights directly leads to errors. 

Is there a recommended approach to do this as direct loading doesnt work.
